compatibility.reason: Android OS security architecture requires identical applicationId for in-place updates. Target package is com.miyori.music whereas installed package is com.example.auralis.

migration.packageIdentityExplanation: Android OS PackageManagerService enforces application sandbox isolation by package name. Because the package identifier changed from com.example.auralis to com.miyori.music, Android treats Miyori as a distinct, separate application. In-place replacement of com.example.auralis by com.miyori.music is technically impossible under the Android OS security model.
migration.coexistenceGuarantee: Both Auralis and Miyori can be installed side-by-side on the same device without conflict. Installing Miyori will never delete, corrupt, or modify your existing Auralis app or files.
migration.dataPreservationNotice: Shared audio files saved in standard device storage (e.g., Music/Miyori or shared audio folders) with ID3v2.4 tags remain completely accessible and are automatically indexed by Miyori on first launch. However, internal app databases, in-app playlists, and private settings stored inside /data/data/com.example.auralis/ do NOT transfer automatically across different application IDs due to Android application sandboxing.
recoveryGuidance: If installation is blocked: Open Android Settings -> Apps -> Special App Access -> Install unknown apps, and enable permission for your browser or file manager.
If 'App not installed' error occurs: Verify at least 50 MB of free internal storage, and ensure the downloaded APK SHA-256 matches 8ddb0520f46a6a7ae28c5ca178fc54e160ad36c087de38cec8ef543bc59104e4.
If a corrupt download occurs: Delete the damaged file from your Downloads folder and re-download from https://miyori.vercel.app/Miyori-Release.apk.
stepByStepFlow: Step 2: Tap the downloaded file to install. Android will install MIYORI as a new app alongside Auralis.
Step 3: Launch MIYORI and grant Audio / Media permissions; all existing local music files are discovered automatically.
Step 4: Verify playback. You may safely keep Auralis as a backup or uninstall it whenever desired.

futureUpdates.updatePolicy: All future Miyori releases will retain the applicationId 'com.miyori.music' and the same signing certificate, incrementing versionCode sequentially (15, 16, etc.) to guarantee seamless in-place updates without requiring migration.
